name: HostIntel — API on RapidAPI
description:
Know what a host exposes before you trust it: HostIntel takes an IP address and returns a security profile — open ports, hostnames and known vulnerabilities — in a single structured response.

What you get:
- Open ports and the services observed on the host, from the Shodan InternetDB dataset
- Hostnames and tags associated with the IP, for asset inventory and triage
- Known vulnerability identifiers (CVEs) reported for the host's exposed services
- A single-call profile format designed for screening: vendor IPs, customer servers, webhook sources, sign-in origins

Key endpoints:
- GET /lookup — full host intelligence profile for an IP address
- GET /ports — open ports observed for an IP address

Batch / built for workflows:
HostIntel is a screening step inside larger workflows: run it at vendor onboarding, when a new server or endpoint appears in your logs, or as a periodic re-check of infrastructure you depend on. Each lookup is one self-contained call with one structured profile out, so it drops cleanly into automation platforms (n8n, Make, Zapier) and internal scripts without custom parsing per data source.

Access: subscribe on RapidAPI (free tier available); calls are made over HTTPS with your RapidAPI key.
